verdict.rationale: TeamViewer ships its own AI features, including the Tia agent and an AI troubleshooting assistant, so asking whether it can act as an MCP client is fair. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to or use external MCP servers. Its Web API and AI assistant features are adjacent capabilities and do not count as MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
